La nostra storia

From Floridia, Sicily — straight to SeaTac.

Fourteen-year-old Dario Brancato stepped off the plane with his parents, Pippo and Lilla, and his two brothers — a whole family starting over on the far side of the world.

Dario grew up cooking beside his mother and his grandmother, then spent nearly twenty years in Italian kitchens around Gig Harbor and Seattle.

The recipes on the menu came down the same road the family did — nonna to mother to Dario.

1995The Brancatos land in Washington.
2015Dario & Pippo open Il Siciliano.
OggiHis father and his wife still work beside him.
La cantina

The cellar speaks Italian.

The arched wall you walk in past isn’t decor — it’s the working cellar. Roughly 80% of the wine list is Italian, poured alongside the Italian oils and spices the kitchen cooks with.

Ask for a bottle to match your plate — this is a family that takes its wine as seriously as its sauce.
